summary.para: Create or update an ES|QL view.
Stores an ES|QL query that runs whenever the view is referenced. A query that cannot be parsed is rejected. Replacing a reserved view fails.
A free-text description of the view.
The view name to create or update.
The ES|QL query string that defines the view. A query that cannot be parsed is rejected.
Whether to analyze the view query and return a warning when validation fails.

Validation reports an unknown index or column, including an index the caller cannot read. The view is saved even when validation reports a problem. Failures unrelated to the query, such as an overloaded cluster, produce no warning.
